Contact Number 
0415 072 863 

Locations 
The Wellness Collective (Birkdale)
Carbrook at my home 
Mobile to you - Brisbane to Gold Coast 

Availability 
I have fairly open availability, contact me with a date & time & we'll go from there ( :

Time Options 
45, 60, 90, 120min booking options 

Offerings 
Yoga 1:1  (YIN, RESTORATIVE, GENTLE FLOW, HATHA, VINYASA) meditation inclusive 
Sound healing/ bath experience (sound instruments & guided meditation) 
Massage 
lomi lomi (traditional hawaiian massage, lymphatic drainage promotion) 
relaxation 
facials 
indian head massage 
I am also open to packages & bundles of multiple sessions or cross over treatments ( : 
Prices vary depending on session type, please text or call to enquire 0415 072 863 

Background
I come from nursing those in addiction recovery & mental health NDIS participants. I'm a humanitarian & feel deeply everyone deserves love, compassion & space to heal. 

I've worked in rehabs doing 1:1 & group facilitations on the gold coast then transitioned into yoga studios where I then began to add onto my skills and qualifications and continue to study massage and work at bathhouses in brisbane! 
which further developed my confidence & connection to higher self, guiding me in the pursuance of my own endeavours. 

"Every person has a different experience in my space, each session personal, private & sacred."  

What lights me up about the work I do is the honour of giving someone the space to surrender & just be in presence. Also, the overall energy shift of clients from beginning of the session/ practice to the end... moving.
